svg.title: Ferrix Gantt
svg.text: Ferrix: done, in progress, and a forecast
The forecast is one queue at 20 points a day, built rows first, then shortest first: the size of the work, not a plan; hollow rows have no session on them
In progress: solid is done; the faint bar is the wait for the queue below (built rows first, then shortest first), the light dashed bar the work itself; a dotted bar to the edge is unsized work
Authentication P1, P2 (desktop as a user)
NVIDIA N2 to N4 and the TV (64)
Pixel 7: USB beyond the console driver
Client pages as texture backing (8, idle)
Pixel 7, the USB driver's rest (37, added)
IPC round trip to seL4's figure (69, added)
